title: Cross-GPU slab synthesis: throughput & cost-per-token analysis (A10/L4/A100/H100)
creator: Ava Patel
description: Objective: Run a cross-GPU slab synthesis to produce a single canonical report comparing tokens/sec, p95 latency, and cost-per-1M-tokens across A10, L4, A100, and H100 under production-like request mixes. This ticket covers harness improvements (hybrid batching + prefix warmers), standardized trace tags for regression detection, and a baseline ingest for automated drift alerts. Deliverables: reproducible load harness, canonical dashboards, regression rules, and an executive cost matrix for runbook recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: Reproducible harness that can run the same scenario across A10/L4/A100/H100 via a single config file
Canonical report produced (CSV + dashboard) with tokens/sec, p95, median, error rates, and cost-per-1M-tokens
Regression detection rules implemented and firing in synthetic test runs (see regression_detection_rules)
PRs merged for harness changes and a runnable job in CI that seeds baseline metrics
test_plan: Workload profiles: small-chat (avg 80 tokens), long-gen (avg 1024 tokens), mix50 (50/50 small/long)
Sequence length fixed at 1024 for long-gen runs; measure cold vs warmed KV cache
Batching: evaluate static batch sizes and hybrid continuous batching window 5-50ms
Run 6 steady-state passes per GPU type, collect 30-minute sample windows after warmup
Inject 5% tail workload (burst of concurrent requests) to surface p95 behavior
progress_updates: 2026-02-16: Initial harness prototype using tokenflow harness merged; added ability to parametrize GPU flavor via --gpu-type
2026-02-22: Added hybrid batching window and prefix warmer; observed 6-9% improvement on L4 in internal smoke tests
2026-03-02: Standardized trace tags (gpu_type, slab_id, warm_state); pushed to trace-indexer for dashboard joins
2026-03-08: Completed full runs for A10/L4; A100/H100 runs queued (billing quota escalation requested)
2026-03-10: First canonical report produced and uploaded; regression rules proposed (see regression_detection_rules)
Blocked: Waiting for H100 quota increase from infra to complete final runs (expected 2026-03-12)
results_summary: Summary for mix50 profile (after warmup, sequence length favoring long-gen behavior): tokens/sec (mean): A10=1,250 tps, L4=2,700 tps, A100=4,600 tps, H100=9,400 tps. p95 latency (per-token effective): A10=92ms, L4=48ms, A100=26ms, H100=11ms. Error rates negligible (<0.1%) in steady-state. Cost-per-1M-tokens (spot pricing normalized): A10=$0.42, L4=$0.20, A100=$0.11, H100=$0.07. Notes: L4 provides best cost/latency balance for small/medium models; H100 dominates throughput for large-batch high-throughput needs but has higher tail variability when KV cache cold. Results attached in canonical CSV artifact.
regression_detection_rules: tokens/sec drop > 7% vs baseline (7-day rolling baseline) triggers P0 alert
p95 increase > 15% vs baseline triggers P1 investigation ticket
error-rate increase > 0.5 percentage points triggers immediate rollback on canary routes
cost-per-1M-tokens increase > 10% attributed to kernel regression flagged in nightly regression report
next_steps: Complete H100 runs once infra quota granted and re-generate canonical report
Wire regression rules into alerting playbook and add automatic bisect job that narrows commits when a rule fires
Produce a short exec one-pager recommending default GPU flavor per workload archetype and updated runbook entries
Automate monthly re-run (cron) and store baselines in time-series with version tags to enable drift analysis
